name: Collections & Recovery
description: Delinquent account treatment, roll rates, cures, and recoveries.

metrics.name: roll_rate
metrics.description: Balances rolling to the next delinquency bucket divided by the starting bucket

metrics.name: cure_rate
metrics.description: Balances returning to current divided by delinquent balances

metrics.name: recoveries
metrics.description: Amounts recovered on charged-off accounts in the period

conventions.rule: Roll rates compare the same balances month over month; state count or balance basis.
Treatment choices must follow consumer-protection rules; analytics cannot recommend actions for individuals.

insight_rules.reason: Attribute via numerator and denominator balances.

caveats.text: Changes in charge-off or forbearance policy change roll and cure rates mechanically.

chart_conventions.rule: Show roll rates as a bucket-to-bucket matrix table.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
